# RANDOM FOREST APPROACH

#### After creating a model that can determine the amount of protein coding genes, I wanted to go for a different approach for something that does not have a linear relationship. For that I wanted to approach to predict AMR based on metadata like serotype, source type, and even month of the year. 
```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(here)
library(vip)

# Read data
amr_long_rf <- read_csv(here("data/processed-data/amr_long.csv"))

amr_long_rf <- amr_long_rf %>%
  mutate(AMR_class_strict = if_else(AMR_status == "COMPLETE", AMR_class, "NO AMR"))
```

```{r}
amr_wide_rf <- amr_long_rf %>%
  select(Create.date, BioSample, AMR_class_strict, serotype, Source.type) %>%
  distinct(BioSample, AMR_class_strict, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Create.date, BioSample, serotype, Source.type),
    names_from = AMR_class_strict,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = 0
  ) 

amr_wide_rf$`Efflux Pump` = NULL
amr_wide_rf$`NO AMR` = NULL 

amr_wide_rf <- amr_wide_rf %>%
  mutate(
    sample_year = as.factor(year(Create.date)),
    sample_month = month(Create.date, label = TRUE),
    total_amr_classes = rowSums(across(c("Aminoglycoside", "Fosfomycin","Beta_lactam", "Gentamicin", "Trimethoprim", "Quinolone", "Phenicol", "Colistin", "Macrolide", "Bleomycin", "Tetracycline", "Sulfonamide", "Lincosamide"))),
    amr_prevalence = if_else(total_amr_classes == 0, 0, 1),
    mdr_prevalence = if_else(total_amr_classes <= 3, 0, 1)
  )
```

```{r}
# Get the total number of isolates
totaln_isolates <- nrow(amr_wide_rf)

top_20_serovars <- amr_wide_rf %>%
    group_by(serotype) %>%
    summarise(
        n = n(),
        amr_positive = sum(amr_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE),
        mdr_positive = sum(mdr_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        serovar_pct = round(n / totaln_isolates * 100, 1),
        amr_pct = round(amr_positive / totaln_isolates * 100, 1),
        mdr_pct = round(mdr_positive / totaln_isolates * 100, 1)
    ) %>%
     slice_max(n, n = 20, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
         arrange(desc(amr_positive)) 

```

```{r}
#Creating list with top serovars
top_20 <- c("I 4,[5],12:i:-", "Infantis", "Typhimurium", "Newport", "Agona", "Kentucky", "Enteritidis", "Anatum",     "Saintpaul", "Braenderup", "Muenchen", "Sandiego", "Javiana", "Montevideo", "Oranienburg", "Thompson", "Mississippi", "Bareilly", "Poona", "Rubislaw")

# Creating the new column to  "Other" for serovars that are not in the top 20
amr_wide_rf <- amr_wide_rf %>%
  mutate(top_20 = if_else(serotype %in% top_20, serotype, "Other"))
```


```{r}
# Set seed
rngseed <- 1234
set.seed(rngseed)


amr_wide_rf <- amr_wide_rf %>%
  mutate(Tetracycline = factor(Tetracycline, levels = c(1, 0)))

set.seed(rngseed)
split <- initial_split(amr_wide_rf, prop = 0.75, strata = Tetracycline)

train_data <- training(split)
test_data  <- testing(split)

rf_spec <- rand_forest(
  mode = "classification",
  trees = 500,
  mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(train_data) - 1)),
  min_n = 5
) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", seed = rngseed, importance = "permutation")


rf_fit1 <- rf_spec %>%
  fit(Tetracycline ~ Source.type + top_20, data = train_data)

rf_fit1
```

```{r}
test_pred1 <- test_data %>%
  bind_cols(
    predict(rf_fit1, new_data = test_data),                 # class
    predict(rf_fit1, new_data = test_data, type = "prob")   # probabilities
  )

conf_mat(test_pred1, truth = Tetracycline, estimate = .pred_class)
sens(test_pred1, truth = Tetracycline, estimate = .pred_class)
spec(test_pred1, truth = Tetracycline, estimate = .pred_class)
accuracy(test_pred1, truth = Tetracycline, estimate = .pred_class)
precision(test_pred1, truth = Tetracycline, estimate = .pred_class)
f_meas(test_pred1, truth = Tetracycline, estimate = .pred_class) 

roc_curve(test_pred1, truth = Tetracycline, .pred_1) %>%
  autoplot()

roc_auc(test_pred1, truth = Tetracycline, .pred_1)
```

```{r}
ggplot(test_pred1, aes(x = .pred_1, fill = Tetracycline)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
# Extract and plot
rf_fit1 %>%
  extract_fit_engine() %>%
  vip(num_features = 10) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Variable Importance for Tetracycline Resistance Prediction")
```

```{r}
# 1. Create a function to extract all metrics at once
get_metrics <- function(pred_df, model_name) {
  metrics_set <- metric_set(accuracy, sens, spec, precision, f_meas, roc_auc)
  
  metrics_set(pred_df, truth = Tetracycline, estimate = .pred_class, .pred_1) %>%
    mutate(model = model_name) %>% # Add a column to identify the model
    select(model, .metric, .estimate)
}

# 2. Collect metrics for all 4 fits
# (Assuming you have test_pred1, test_pred2, test_pred3, and test_pred4)
all_results <- bind_rows(
  get_metrics(test_pred1, "Model 1: Base"),
  get_metrics(test_pred2, "Model 2: Seasonal"),
  get_metrics(test_pred3, "Model 3: Negative correlation"),
  get_metrics(test_pred4, "Model 4: Positive correlation")
)

# 3. Pivot the table for a side-by-side comparison
comparison_table <- all_results %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = .estimate)

print(comparison_table)
```
